claim_en: THE INSTALLATION RECIPE. ve-den pitgama ('and THIS IS THE PROCEDURE') — the first PERSONNEL install: immersion in water FIRST, the dressing order, the anointing oil on the head — and the office's own perpetuity at 29:9: kehunta li-KEYAM ALAM ('the priesthood as an EVERLASTING STATUTE'); the fill-the-hand idiom rendered OFFER THEIR OFFERING throughout.

THE HANDS AND THE BODY IN THE RITE. ve-yismokh yat yedehon ('they shall LEAN their hands on the head') — the leaning-rite's first corpus appearance, three times; the blood-map on the persons (right ear-tip, right thumb, right big toe); oil and blood sprinkled on the garments themselves — man and clothing consecrated as one unit.

THE SACRIFICIAL TAXONOMY BOOTS. chatata ('SIN-OFFERING') named with its full protocol — blood on the horns BY THE FINGER, the rest at the BASE, fats up, flesh burned OUTSIDE THE CAMP; alata ('BURNT-OFFERING') whole on the altar; and THE ACCEPTANCE TRANSFORM: reach nichoach ('pleasing fragrance') rendered le-itkabbala be-RAAVA ('to be ACCEPTED WITH FAVOR') three times — smell de-anthropomorphized into acceptance.

source: Onkelos on Exod 29:22-28; the waving row at Mishnah Menachot 5:6
claim_en: THE WAVE AND THE PERPETUAL DUES. aramuta ('the LIFTING' — the wave-offering) on the open hands; the breast to Moses; and the dues: breast and thigh li-keyam alam from the sons of Israel from their peace-offerings — AFRASHUTA ('a SEPARATION,' 29:28): the same separation-word as EX25-01's gift — the priestly-dues economy wired in the terumah vocabulary (Mishnah Menachot 5:6, this exam's docket).

source: Onkelos on Exod 29:29-30; the succession frame at Midrash Tanchuma, Tetzaveh 9
claim_en: THE OFFICE TRANSFERS BY GARMENT. Aaron's garments to his sons AFTER HIM — anointed and installed IN THEM; seven days the successor wears them. The spine's rider: the Moses-to-Joshua succession table, and the student-before-master law (Joshua's ten years shortened for ten words spoken before his teacher).

source: Onkelos on Exod 29:31-34; the docket row at Mishnah Pesachim 8:8
claim_en: THE SACRED MEAL AND ITS FENCES. Cooked in a HOLY PLACE; eaten by THOSE IT ATONED; ve-chilonai la yekhul ('a COMMON MAN shall not eat — for they are holy'); leftover to morning BURNED — the notar law repeating the Passover's 12:10 shape (Mishnah Pesachim 8:8 anchors at 29:33 in this exam's docket).

source: Onkelos on Exod 29:35-37; the scoping row at Mishnah Zevachim 9:1
claim_en: SEVEN DAYS, THEN CONTAGION. The altar atoned and anointed seven days, becoming MOST HOLY — and then the transfer law: kol de-yikrab be-madbecha YITKADASH ('WHATEVER TOUCHES THE ALTAR BECOMES HOLY') — sanctity as a contact function; the tradition's scoping waits at Mishnah Zevachim 9:1 (the altar sanctifies what is FIT for it).

THE DAILY HEARTBEAT. Two yearling lambs le-yoma TEDIRA ('each day, CONTINUALLY') — morning and ben shimshaya ('between the suns') — with the flour-oil-wine measures (the crushed oil again at 29:40): alata tedira le-darekhon ('a CONTINUAL burnt-offering for your generations') — the tamid installed at the ordination's close.

THE SECOND ANSWER ADDRESS, AND THE PURPOSE CLAUSE. de-ezammen MEMRI lekhon tamman ('where I will APPOINT MY WORD for YOU there') — the appointment-verb and Word-layer of EX25-05, now at the TENT ENTRANCE, addressed to the plural and extended to the sons of Israel, sanctified bi-KARI ('with My GLORY'); then ve-ashrei SHEKHINTI among the sons of Israel — and the exodus' stated purpose: brought out of Egypt TO REST MY PRESENCE AMONG THEM (29:46).

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Tetzaveh 10 (with Buber 10's purchase clause)
claim_en: THE ELEVATION IS AN AMNESTY ANNOUNCEMENT. The calf background: Hur killed for rebuking the mob, Aaron acting from FEAR — and the priesthood grant is the PUBLIC SIGN that nothing is held against him; the species keyed to the sin: the BULL atones for the CALF, the two rams answer the two sons destined to die; and the ownership clause — the bull by PURCHASE and not from PLUNDER.

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Tetzaveh 13 + the Buber census
claim_en: THE LI-FOREVER TOKEN. R. Mana in R. Eliezer's name: wherever Scripture says LI ('for Me'), it stands FOREVER — with the census: firstborn, silver and gold, kingship, land, Israel, Levites, and THE PRIESTHOOD (le-khahen LI, our 29:1); riding: the exclusivity clause (this tribe and no other) and the purity curriculum (how they immerse, purify, and eat).

THE INSTITUTION-CONSEQUENCE TABLE. Kind blesses kind while the offerings run; and the cessation map — Haggai 1:6 and Habakkuk 3:17 clause by clause: showbread/sown-much-brought-little, wine libation/drink-not-filled, THE GARMENTS/clothed-and-not-warm, THE DAILY OFFERING/wages-into-a-holed-bag, the light oil/the olive's labor failed — with Mishnah Sotah 9:12 quoted inside the spine.

Forward-and-back from the wave-verb, up-and-down from the lift-verb — the Mishnah quotes our 29:27 as the proof (Mishnah Menachot 5:6); the waving census rides (men and women alike, Israel not others; waving east, bringing-near west, wavings first). Seated from the Step 9 Tetzaveh exam, auto-seat law.
